summary: One exact signed constrained-HTTP write lease can be reissued once only after a trusted separately authenticated observer proves that the same external action was not started after durable first-attempt consumption.
boundaries: The observer signer is trusted customer-local infrastructure and must not be exposed to an upstream agent or arbitrary plugin.
The action and observer bindings are separate, but the joined fixture does not prove process or failure-domain independence.
The local host clock is trusted; there is no external monotonic rollback anchor.
Only the exact not-started classification can authorize one second attempt; no third attempt or automatic compensation exists.
This is one local fictional constrained-HTTP route, not customer, production, hostile-administrator, arbitrary-API, public, or general retry evidence.
freezeRule: Any change to a listed file requires a new checkpoint and regenerated hashes.
